t.zh: 照片中物体的轮廓常伴随亮度变化。怎样区分由暗到亮与由亮到暗的变化，并同时观察两个方向？先比较一行的相邻值，再用<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>处理图像。手算题给出窗口位置的权重；电路题采用二维元件的书写<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>约定，注意核对两种顺序。
t.en: Object outlines in a photograph often coincide with intensity changes. How can dark-to-bright and bright-to-dark changes be distinguished in both directions? First compare neighbouring values in a row, then process the image with <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>. The hand calculation gives positional window weights; the circuit uses the 2D part’s written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> convention. Reconcile the two orders.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出横向响应 gx（右邻减左邻，竖直用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）和纵向响应 gy（下邻减上邻，横向用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）
desc.en: Takes an image; gives the across response gx (right less left, averaged [1, 2, 1] down) and the down response gy (below less above, averaged [1, 2, 1] across)

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>的带符号响应反映亮度变化的方向；平坦区域即使很亮也可能没有响应。图像边界的补零则可能产生额外响应。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
after.en: Signed <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> responses indicate the direction of intensity change. A bright flat region can have zero response, while zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> can create extra responses at image boundaries.

brief.zh: 只看横向：每格算右邻减左邻（图外补 0），写出结果。
brief.en: Across only: at each cell take the right neighbour less the left (0 outside) and write the result.

hint.zh: 从暗到亮的地方是正，从亮到暗呢？平的地方呢？
hint.en: Dark to bright is positive; and bright to dark? And where it is flat?

why.zh: 这是只看变化有多大：响应带符号，从亮到暗的地方右邻比左邻暗，是负的。
why.en: That records only how big the change is: the response is signed, and where it goes bright to dark the right neighbour is darker, so it is negative.

brief.zh: 输入一张图，输出 gx、gy。书写的<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>：gx 横向 [1,0,−1]、纵向 [1,2,1]；gy 横向 [1,2,1]、纵向 [1,0,−1]。沿坐标正方向从暗到亮，响应应为正。
brief.en: Given an image, output gx and gy. Written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs: gx uses [1,0,−1] across and [1,2,1] down; gy uses [1,2,1] across and [1,0,−1] down. Dark-to-bright along a positive coordinate direction must give a positive response.

hint.zh: 两个响应都是二维滤波器，只是权重不同。
hint.en: Both responses are 2D filters with different weights.

solution: x = filter2D(image, o, z, m, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, o, z, m)
naive: x = filter2D(image, m, z, o, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)
